pick.title: Isolectra Streda
pick.description:
Found {count} Streda box(es) on your network. Choose yours, or enter the IP address yourself.

This integration uses its own connection, next to any MQTT setup you already have. It only reads from the box; it sends a command only when you switch a device.

manual.title: Isolectra Streda
manual.description:
Enter the IP address of your Streda box (reserve a fixed address for it in your router). The automatic search only finds boxes on Home Assistant's own network that don't require a login. [How to find the IP address]({find_ip_url})

This integration uses its own connection, next to any MQTT setup you already have. It only reads from the box; it sends a command only when you switch a device.

data.host: IP address of the Streda box

data_description.username: Leave empty unless your box requires a login.
data_description.base_topic: Leave at zigbee2mqtt unless your box uses another topic.

reconfigure.title: Isolectra Streda
reconfigure.description: Change the connection to your Streda box, for example after it got a new IP address.

data.host: IP address of the Streda box

progress.scan: Looking for Streda boxes on your network. This takes up to half a minute; nothing on your network is changed.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the Streda box. Check the IP address and port, and that Home Assistant is on the same network.
error.invalid_auth: The Streda box refused the username or password.
error.no_device_list: Connected, but no device list was received within 10 seconds. Is this a Streda box, and is the base topic correct?

abort.already_configured: This Streda box is already set up.
abort.reconfigure_successful: The connection to the Streda box was updated.
